description.content: Actions API.

Get a list of actions.

**Required API permission level:** `DEV`

query.description: Filter actions by their type. Type can be any one of the enumerated values.
Agent pool ID. Mandatory when RBAC is enabled. Ignored when RBAC is disabled.
Filter actions created after the specified date. Date format is <YYYY-MM-DD>.
Filter actions created before the specified date. Date format is <YYYY-MM-DD>. (UTC)
Filter actions created by the specified user or API key. Users are identified by their email address.
Filter actions by their state. State can be either ‘true’ (enabled) or ‘false’ (disabled).
Filter actions by their expiration state. Expiration state can be either ‘true’ (expired) or ‘false’ (disabled).

Filter actions by the file on which they were set. Files are indicated by their full path, as provided in the action’s creation. This filter supports * as a wildcard to match multiple file names with a common pattern.
Filter actions which have any errors. The flag can be either ‘true’ (with errors) or ‘false’ (without errors).
Specifies a zero-based index of the results page to retrieve. The default is 0 (the first page).
Filter actions based on whether results have (true) or haven’t (false) been captured for them.
The number of items to include on each page of results. The default is 20.

The sorting criteria in the format property (asc|desc), with ascending as the default. Multiple sort parameters can be chained to define primary, secondary, and further sorting levels (e.g., sort=field1,asc&sort=field2,desc). Sortable fields: location, line, createdAt.

The sorting criteria in the format property (asc|desc), with ascending as the default. Multiple sort parameters can be chained to define primary, secondary, and further sorting levels (e.g., sort=field1,asc&sort=field2,desc). Sortable fields: location, line, createdAt.
Filter actions by status. Status can be any one of the enumerated values.

response.name: OK
